help.intro: Questions about Prollegen, your order or your account? Start here, or speak directly with our support team.
help.holiday_note: Response times may vary on holidays.

help.faq_product_a: Prollegen combines whey protein isolate with Type I and III collagen peptides, Vitamin C, MSM and DigeZyme® digestive enzymes for performance, recovery and everyday wellbeing.
help.faq_sizes_a: Prollegen is currently available in 500g and 1kg sizes, offering approximately 16 and 33 servings respectively.
help.faq_delivery_a: Typical delivery is estimated at 3–7 business days to serviceable locations across India. Final timing is shown during checkout.
help.faq_shipping_a: Free shipping applies to orders of ₹4,499 and above.
help.faq_cod_a: COD is available on eligible orders and serviceable locations. Eligibility is confirmed during checkout.
help.faq_returns_q: How do returns and refunds work?
help.faq_returns_a: Please contact support with your order number before returning anything. Final eligibility follows our published return and refund policy.
help.faq_accounts_a: Shopify customer accounts use secure passwordless verification. Your profile, addresses, orders and tracking details are managed through Shopify.
